definitions.explanation: The Olympic Games. The name comes from the five interlocking rings of the Olympic symbol. This is the common short form used in everyday Japanese, especially in newspaper headlines and casual speech.

examples.japanese: {五輪|ごりん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開会式|かいかいしき}→開会式：27306_kaikaishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched the Olympic opening ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{五輪|ごりん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{金|きん}メダル→金メダル：20781_kinmedaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: She won a gold medal at the Olympics.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏季|かき}→夏季：12102_kaki⟧{五輪|ごりん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}される→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: People are watching to see which city will host the next Summer Olympics.

notes:
USAGE: {五輪|ごりん} literally means "five rings," referring to the five Olympic rings. It is the standard short form of ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧ in Japanese, especially common in newspaper headlines where space is limited.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{夏季|かき}→夏季：12102_kaki⟧{五輪|ごりん} (Summer Olympics)
- ⟦{冬季|とうき}→冬季：11755_touki⟧{五輪|ごりん} (Winter Olympics)
- {五輪|ごりん}⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧ (Olympic athlete)
- {五輪|ごりん}⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧ (Olympic representative)
- {五輪|ごりん}⟦{開催|かいさい}→開催：10457_kaisai⟧ (hosting the Olympics)
- ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧{五輪|ごりん} (Tokyo Olympics)
